name: beautiful-react
description: Write, review, port, and enforce idiomatic React 19 + TypeScript: three skills distilled from the React 19 documentation, the React patterns handbook, the TypeScript strict handbook, and the facta frontend handbook, plus a drop-in eslint config.

interface.longDescription:
Three skills for React 19 + TypeScript developers, distilled from the React 19 documentation, the React patterns handbook, the TypeScript strict handbook, and the facta frontend handbook.

react-best-practices guides new React code: function components and composition, hooks discipline, one discriminated union per screen, derived state instead of mirrored state, the View -> ViewModel -> SDK layer contract, typed errors, forms, a11y, performance, security, and tests.

react-review reviews a component, hook, feature folder, or diff and returns a prioritized report. A broken architecture contract ranks above everything. Every finding cites a file and line, the rule it breaks, and the smallest fix.

react-port ports Vue, Svelte, Angular, jQuery, vanilla JavaScript, or class components to React 19 with the same behavior. It ports the original tests first and writes a PORTING.md that lists every deliberate difference.

The skills contain instructions and reference text only. They make no network calls and collect no data. When a Node.js toolchain is available, the skills run tsc, eslint, and vitest on your project; without one, they work from the code alone. A drop-in eslint config is available in the GitHub repository.
capabilities: Review React code with cited rules
Port UI code to React with the same behavior
defaultPrompt: Review this React feature and list what to fix first
Port this Vue component to idiomatic React
Write a typed ViewModel hook for this screen

publication.release_notes: Initial release: three React skills with the layer contract, a proven eslint config, and JSX review coverage.
